scoreRationale: A genuinely worthwhile small coastal village: an award-winning beach, distinctive fishing-community heritage, community gardens, a strong coastal route and unusually complete practical facilities. Its limited scale, seasonal toilets, very small car park and lack of café keep it in the 60–69 band.

practicalAudit.see: East Haven Beach and the Heritage Point/coastal gardens independently clear 60.
practicalAudit.eat: No café, coffee-and-cake stop, tearoom, bakery café or dependable light-lunch venue was verified in the village.
practicalAudit.picnic: One exact dedicated beach picnic area with tables and BBQ plates.
practicalAudit.parking: One exact free beach car park; the community warns capacity is limited and no count is invented.
practicalAudit.toilets: One exact community-partnership facility, open seasonally from mid-March to the end of October, with accessible provision.
practicalAudit.accessibility: The toilet is accessible and the council describes the coastal route as firm, even and mostly flat; beach surfaces remain naturally variable.
practicalAudit.transport: Bus services connect East Haven with Carnoustie and Arbroath; current timetables should be checked.
